list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (checked 20 Nov 2026; the two lists agree on every name, description and grade). Hidden flags are our best reading of the PSN list: 28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned. Counts (42 Shooting Range challenges, 14 drone-race locations, 18 meditation spots, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 8 garage properties, 9 activity types) are the counts PSNProfiles tracks for those trophies. The game launched 19 Nov 2026, so step-by-step locations have NOT yet been checked in the game; guides say so honestly where that is the case.

PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task for it. Work through this guide in roadmap order — story first, then strangers and side activities, then collectibles and the long grinds last — and the platinum follows. Nothing about the platinum itself needs checking in the game; it is awarded by PlayStation when the set is complete.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end and the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is the first story mission, so it cannot be skipped — just follow the on-screen objectives. Treat it as mission-locked: if you somehow leave the mission unfinished, return to it before moving far into the story. The mission's exact beats have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Chapter trophies are automatic — there is no side requirement, no collectible and no choice to get wrong, just complete the story in order. If you are tracking progress, this is the first chapter marker on the roadmap.

The official description names no choice or condition beyond finishing the mission, but the ending's exact structure has not yet been checked in the game — keep a save before the finale if you want a safety net.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own checklist, which counts story missions, side activities, collectibles and the other tracked tasks — not just the trophy list. This is the second gold trophy and the real endgame: it is usually the last trophy before the platinum, after every stranger strand, collectible set and activity is done. Check the in-game stats page for what still counts toward 100%; the exact checklist has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and the like — across the whole game. The count is cumulative, so chip away at it whenever you are driving between missions instead of grinding it in one sitting. Use fast cars and Leonida's jumps and ramps; the exact list of what counts as a stunt has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game at least once. PSNProfiles tracks 9 activity types for this trophy — sample each one as you meet it (races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and the rest) rather than leaving them all to the end. You do not need to win or master any of them, just try each type once. The full list of the 9 types has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — PSNProfiles tracks 42 of them. This is a skill grind, not a story task: visit the range, learn each challenge's target pattern, and repeat the ones you miss until gold. Do it in short sessions between story missions so it never becomes a wall at the end. The range's location and the 42 challenges' layouts have not yet been checked in the game.

Find each race spot, learn its course, and win once per location; a win anywhere else does not cover a location you have not raced. Work through the map region by region so none is left behind. The 14 locations have not yet been checked in the game.

Enter a new race each time and keep a mental list of the ones you have already won; repeating a won race adds nothing. Mix race types (street, off-road, drone-adjacent events) as you find them across Leonida. The full race list has not yet been checked in the game.

Mark off each spot as you go (or track them in this guide's notes) so the last few are easy to find. The 18 spot locations have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. This is a hunting task tied to the character Bret, so meet Bret, take the hunt, and track the animal rather than shooting wildlife at random. Bring a suitable weapon and approach quietly — a spooked unique animal may be hard to find again. Bret's location and the animal have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick up every card you pass during the story and sweep the map afterwards for the rest; a set only counts when every card in it is found. Start collecting early — the earlier you grab cards in passing, the shorter the final sweep. Card locations and the set lists have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. This is the longest location grind in the list: do a few WAiNKs in every new area you visit during the story so the total builds up naturally, then sweep the remaining areas at the end. The count is per location, so repeating one spot does not help. What WAiNK It is and where it can be used have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges are the game's small tracked tasks, and the count is cumulative across all types, so just play broadly — races, stunts, hunting, activities — and the total climbs on its own. Check the in-game challenge list for the easiest ones still undone when you are close to 50. The full challenge list has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the police and escape. The trick is the escape, not the wanted level: get the heat, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear — do it with your partner still with you. If you are caught or your partner is left behind, try again; it is repeatable in free roam.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the wanted level must stay active through all three robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving between them so the police stay on you but cannot stop you. A fast getaway car parked nearby helps. Shop robbery mechanics have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or enter 100 distinct models. Variety is the point: try every car, bike, truck and boat you see instead of sticking to one favourite, and visit different districts, since rare models cluster in certain areas. The count is cumulative across the whole playthrough. The full vehicle list has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster: start a fight with a group close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. A busy shootout with enemies in the open is the best setup; a lone enemy at a time will never reach five. Combat Focus mechanics have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way no timetable planned. In practice that means taking an aircraft (or another vehicle) out of the airport without following a scheduled departure, most likely by stealing a plane and taking off. Airport security will react, so be ready to fly low and fast. The exact trigger has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This trophy's description is a joke about Rhino tanks: expect it to involve a Rhino tank, most likely surviving or causing chaos in one. The official description gives no count or condition, so the honest guide is to get into a Rhino tank — usually by reaching a high wanted level or finding one at a military site — and see what the game asks. The exact trigger has not yet been checked in the game, and no location is claimed here.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods, and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave, lose any heat, and try again. Jewellery store layouts and detection rules have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — five separate successful vault robberies. The escape is part of the trophy, so plan the getaway before you go in: a fast car, a route away from the police, and no lingering at the scene. Spread the five across the playthrough rather than attempting them back to back. Vault locations and robbery mechanics have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel Leonida's roads — intercept one, stop it, take the money, and get away before the police close in. Blocking the road ahead of the truck and hitting it fast works better than chasing it from behind. Truck routes and robbery mechanics have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — PSNProfiles tracks 52 areas. This is the map-completion trophy: visit every named area of the state, from Vice City to the swamps and the Keys. The in-game map shows which areas you have visited, so sweep the corners and islands last, when the story has opened the whole map. The 52-area list has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang — PSNProfiles tracks 9 gangs. Find each gang's operation, rob it, and move on to the next gang; robbing the same gang twice does not count twice. Keep a list of which gangs you have hit. Gang operation locations have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a bar or vendor with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. It is a small flavour trophy — no skill or grind, just the right place and the right drink. The exact bar has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front. Find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside or aimed at it, and drive out through the window in one go. It is a one-moment stunt, so save before trying in case the first attempt does not trigger it. Showroom locations have not yet been checked in the game.

The description names the alley, so the trophy is tied to that specific place rather than any bowling lane. Play a full game and the trophy should follow. It most likely involves the two protagonists doing something together that draws a crowd or goes public, but the official description gives no place, count or condition, so no specific step is claimed here. Play the story's partner moments and side activities with your partner and watch for it. The exact trigger has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSNProfiles tracks a count to 500 for this trophy, so it is about accumulating decisions across the game, not one single choice. Choose actively whenever the game offers a decision instead of letting prompts time out, and the count should build over a full playthrough. What counts as a choice, and whether any choice is one-time-only, has not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second attempt after failing it once. The most likely reading is to fail a challenge, mission or activity, then pass it on the immediate retry. Do not fear failing things: a failed first attempt followed by a clean second try is exactly what this trophy seems to reward. The exact trigger has not yet been checked in the game.

Explore unusual places, especially at night or off the beaten track, and the event should find you. No location is claimed here: the exact encounter has not yet been checked in the game, and guessing one would be inventing it.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — PSNProfiles tracks 8 of them. Garages cost money, so this trophy pairs with the money trophies: earn, launder and spend deliberately, buying each garage as you can afford it. Check property listings across Leonida so none is missed. The 8 garage locations and prices have not yet been checked in the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it in the app instead of just driving it once — ten registrations, any vehicles, cumulative across the playthrough. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles): register the interesting ones as you discover them. The app's exact steps have not yet been checked in the game.
